verdict.rationale: LangSmith's evaluation docs list "Code rules" as a first-class evaluator type alongside LLM-as-judge and pairwise comparison for scoring experiments. Code-style checks such as format validation and quality heuristics can also run automatically on production traces. The evidence is thin, though: it only names the evaluator type and never shows how custom scorer code is written or returned. Missing for 10: documentation of the custom evaluator authoring API (function signature, score/feedback return format, SDK usage in Python/TS), evidence of defining custom aggregate or summary metrics, and independent hands-on corroboration.
